ModMetaData.name: ↁ Horse Armor (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: DevDesigner, EvilEyeGuy
ModMetaData.description:
Update of DevDesigner's mod ↁ Horse Armor, the standalone version of the horse armor from ↁ House Sanguin. Upon request from the original owner, I will remove it.
Adds armor for horses, each in a back and a front piece: - caparison - dark caparison - horse plate armor - horse bone armor
Changes in this update - Runs on RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. - Uses Animal Apparel: Framework instead of the discontinued Animal Gear. - The armor covers the body, head and legs of the horse, so it actually protects. - Only horses can wear it. - Giddy-Up 2 (Continued) is optional. With it, the rider sits correctly on an armored horse. - With Medieval Overhaul, plate and bone armor can also be made at the anvil. - Def names are unchanged, saves with the original mod keep their horse armor.
Crafting - Caparisons: tailoring bench, needs Complex Clothing. - Plate armor: smithy, needs Plate Armor. - Bone armor: smithy.
